# gitmoap_group_mr_settings (Resource)

Saves the group's own values for the fields you send, creating its settings if it has none; `null` clears a field. Repositories and groups beneath inherit them unless they override. Maintainers and above may change them.

The token needs `mr_settings:manage` and `mr_settings:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitmoap_group_mr_settings" "platform" {
  group_id                     = gitmoap_group.platform.group_id
  delete_source_branch_default = true
  squash_option                = "allow"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `allow_merge_without_pipeline` (Boolean) While `require_pipeline_success` is on: whether a merge request that no pipeline applies to
may merge. Off — the default — blocks it. `null` inherits.
- `block_on_rejection` (Boolean)
- `delete_source_branch_default` (Boolean)
- `merge_method` (String)
- `override_group_settings` (Boolean)
- `require_issue_criteria_green` (Boolean)
- `require_linked_issue` (Boolean)
- `require_pipeline_success` (Boolean) Block the merge until every pipeline that applies to the merge request's head has
succeeded. `null` inherits.
- `squash_option` (String)
- `stack_auto_retarget` (Boolean)
- `stack_enforce_merge_order` (Boolean)
- `stack_restack_strategy` (String)
- `unresolved_threads` (Boolean)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id.
terraform import gitmoap_group_mr_settings.example "<group_id>"
```
